purpose: Document first-party English/Vietnamese discovery and bounded anonymous review of cadastral/geospatial services for Rạch Giá; no runtime/catalog integration.
assessment: A local/provincial cadastral custodian is evidenced by an official Kiên Giang notice referring to a cadastral extract in Rạch Giá and the Văn phòng Đăng ký đất đai. The national geospatial portal is publicly reachable, but its current portal/configuration checks did not yield a usable anonymous parcel feature service. No safe native parcel identity plus full polygon was obtained, so no sample GeoJSON was written.
registryAssessment: true for local/provincial custodian and procedure evidence only; this does not establish citywide public parcel geometry coverage or adapter admission.

officialSources.observation: Official Kiên Giang provincial PDF; its text identifies a cadastral extract for a Rạch Giá parcel and states it was prepared by the former land-use-rights registration office, now the land-registration office. This is direct custodian/procedure evidence, not a public vector endpoint.
Official Vietnam National Spatial Data Infrastructure information portal, fetched anonymously with HTTP 200. The page describes access to national geospatial data and services.
Official national surveying, mapping and geospatial-information authority homepage, fetched anonymously with HTTP 200; it describes national land/GIS information-system responsibilities.

Official national public-service procedure page describing requests for land information/data through the land-registration office or its branch. The page was identified in search results but the bounded direct request timed out.

requestChecks.observation: Anonymous HTML fetched; current JavaScript assets were inspected. The app configuration points to https://dosm.vnsdi.gov.vn/portal and https://dosm.vnsdi.gov.vn/apiportal/api/Values?urlportal=... .
Current portal redirected to /portal/home and returned an application-error page. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, private token, or TLS exception was used.
Current JavaScript/configuration-discovered API route returned {"Message":"An error has occurred."}; no schema, CRS, native ID, or geometry response was available.
Anonymous request timed out after 20 seconds. Search-result content was used only as discovery evidence; no retry with credentials or bypass was attempted.

TLS verification failed because the server presented a self-signed certificate chain. No certificate exception was authorized or used; the separate official PDF URL was retained from first-party search evidence.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if directly evidenced

nativeFieldMapping.source: No parcel feature schema response obtained; official procedure evidence refers generically to cadastral-map extracts and land data.
nativeFieldMapping.mappingStatus: not qualified; no feature rows joined or retained

uncertainty: The WUP point is a city locator, not a parcel identity.
The public national portal was reachable, but its current viewer/API returned server errors before any layer schema or CRS could be inspected.
The provincial notice demonstrates cadastral-document production for Rạch Giá, not complete public citywide parcel geometry.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel identity and unchanged full polygon were verified.
